{{Quote|Equipped with expensive computers and gadgets, I found what I'd like to call "Spy's Haven" while exploring the deserts in the south eastern area, near Mos Eisley.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (1/8)}}</ref>}}
The '''Spy's Haven''' was the name given by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] to a small camp established on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], not far from [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:AEL" /> The camp was made of a simple tent that contained an impressive amount of computers and electronic devices.<ref name="SWG" /> The camp was sudenly abandoned by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A few days later, the camp was found by a band of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] as well as by the explorer Tinrilo x'Rilsam. The Jawas immediately started to scavenge the place but they fled when the explorer arrived. Despite his advanced [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] skills, x'Rilsam was unsuccessful with the computers and did not manage to obtain any information. The explorer assumed that Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] were stationed there before run off by the local wild life.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spy's Haven was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Spy's Haven was one of many unmarked points of interests on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (1/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the Spy's Haven.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />
